# IR-EMPOWER — Workshop on Infrared Emissivity Measurements

IR-EMPOWER is the community workshop dedicated specifically to **infrared
emissivity measurement**: techniques and protocols, intercomparisons and
databases, modelling and simulation, and thermophysical metrology and its
applications. Where the field's larger conferences treat emissivity as one
topic among many, IR-EMPOWER is the meeting where it is the only topic —
the laboratories of the [research map](/network/index.html) in one room.

The series was founded in 2024 by the **Thermomat / HAIRL group at the
University of the Basque Country (EHU)** in Bilbao, and continues with
editions hosted by member laboratories of the network — the second at the
[Center for Applied Energy Research (CAE)](/network/cae-wuerzburg.html) in
Würzburg in 2026. It is one of the community's
[research networks](/network/index.html#research-networks).

## Editions

{{< include _editions.qmd >}}

The [2026 programme](/ir-empower/2026/index.html) lists all 21 talks; the
[2024 archive](/ir-empower/2024/index.html) keeps the first edition's programme,
speakers and committees.

## The series and the community

IR-EMPOWER contributions are among the public evidence used by the research
map's [methodology](/network/methodology.html) to document which institutions
are active in emissivity measurement. Announcements for upcoming editions
appear in [News](/news/index.html) and on the
[conference calendar](/events-news/conferences.html).
:::
